# Kyanite

Kyanite is a lightweight Linux distribution and Android application focused on privacy, security and portability.

Official website:
https://stringmanolo.github.io/KyaniteAndroid/

## Projects

- KyaniteAndroid: https://github.com/StringManolo/KyaniteAndroid
- Kyanite Linux distribution: https://github.com/StringManolo/Kyanite

## What is KyaniteAndroid?

KyaniteAndroid is an Android application that allows users to run a Linux environment without root access.

## Features

- Linux terminal on Android.
- Kyanite Linux root filesystem.
- Proot execution.
- QEMU ARM64 virtualization.
- Encrypted system storage using AES-256-GCM.
- PIN protection and duress PIN.
- Ephemeral sessions.
- Anti-forensic wipe.
- Network isolation using a local VPN.
- Floating terminal window.
- Support for importing and downloading Linux distributions.

## Supported environments

- Kyanite
- Alpine Linux
- Ubuntu
- Arch Linux ARM
- Others
- Custom rootfs
